empty: No notifications yet. Payment reminders will appear here at their time.
loadFailed: Could not load notifications. Try refreshing the page.

clear.title: Clear {count, plural, one {# read notification} other {# read notifications}}?
clear.text: Only the notifications go away. Payments, transactions and reminders stay as they are.

push.failed: Could not change push on this device. Try again.

off.title: Push notifications on this device
off.text: Reminders arrive even when Saldo is closed. Without push they still appear here.

on.title: Push is on for this device
on.text: Reminders arrive on this device even when Saldo is closed.

denied.title: Notifications are blocked in the browser
denied.text: Allow notifications for this site in the browser settings and come back here. Reminders stay here meanwhile.

homeScreen.title: On iPhone and iPad, push works from the Home Screen
homeScreen.text: Safari sends push only to an app added to the Home Screen: tap Share, then Add to Home Screen, open Saldo from its icon and enable push there.

unavailable.title: Push is not available on this device
unavailable.text: This browser or app does not support push. Reminders stay here, in the notification centre.

rules.title: Reminders
rules.offset: {days, plural, =0 {On the due day} one {# day before} other {# days before}}

hint.subscription: By default, 3 and 2 days before the charge. Reminders stop once the payment is marked paid.
hint.credit: By default, on the instalment's due day. Reminders stop once the instalment is paid.
hint.debt: No reminders by default. Turn on to be reminded before the repayment date.
